lure: A federal agent says your savings are at risk
ask: Move your money to a Bitcoin ATM and tell nobody

message.subject: Urgent: protect your savings today
message.body: I am a federal agent. Your savings are at risk. Do not tell your bank. Move your money today to a Bitcoin ATM to protect it. Keep this secret.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: No agent asks this.
reasons: No government agency moves savings to Bitcoin.
Secrecy and urgency are the marks of a scam.
